notes: Fetched the exact JL Audio C1-650 Owner's Manual (the document heading identifies the C1-650 6.50-inch 2-way component system; it is not the C1-650x). The manual specifies 50 W continuous power handling, 4-ohm nominal impedance, 48 Hz–24 kHz ±3 dB system response, a 6.50-inch woofer and a 1.0-inch woofer voice coil. JL labels its acoustic rating 'Efficiency': 90.5 dB @ 1 W/1 m and 96.5 dB @ 1 W/0.5 m; it separately lists 93.0 dB @ 2.83 V/1 m. The stored sensitivity is only the published 1 W/1 m figure; no conversion or impedance-derived normalization is made. The 10–75 W/ch recommended-amplifier range is not stored as scalar power. The manual lists two woofers and two tweeters in the passive kit; driverCount is 2 per speaker side, and active=false reflects its external amplifier/passive crossover arrangement. The response bounds retain the manual's ±3 dB context in this note; no response points, resonance or directivity data are imported. Source: https://www.bobscb.com/PDGManuals/C1-650_MAN.pdf.

Fetched the exact JL Audio C3-650 Owner's Manual: it identifies a 6.50-inch convertible 2-way component system, with two C3-650cw woofers and two C3-100ct tweeters in the kit. It specifies 75 W continuous power handling, 4-ohm nominal impedance, 48 Hz–25 kHz ±3 dB system response, 90.0 dB efficiency @ 1 W/1 m, a 6.50-inch woofer and a 1.2-inch (31 mm) woofer voice coil. Sensitivity uses the manual's explicit 1 W/1 m reference; no conversion is made. DriverCount is 2 per speaker side despite the kit being sold as a pair, and active=false reflects the external amplifier and passive crossover network; the convertible coaxial/component mounting option does not change the per-side transducer count. No peak or recommended-amplifier figure is promoted into the scalar power field. The response bounds retain the manual's ±3 dB context in this note; no response points, resonance or directivity data are imported. Source: https://tacotunes.com/wp-content/uploads/2013/02/JL-Audio-C3-650-Component-Speakers-Manual.pdf.
